title: Deep-learning-enabled multi-omics analyses for prediction of future metastasis in cancer.
authors: Wang, Xiaoying; Duan, Maoteng; Snyder, Anthony J; Su, Po-Lan; Li, Jianying; Krull, Jordan; Jin, Jiacheng; Xu, Yang; Sun, Yuhan; Chen, Hu; Wu, Weidong; Chen, Weiqing; He, Kai; Zhang, Chi; Cao, Sha; Zhao, Jing; Xu, Dong; Wang, Guangyu; Li, Lang; Xin, Gang; Carbone, David P; Li, Zihai; Carpenter, Richard L; Ma, Qin
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习预测癌症转移并识别YY1转录因子作为驱动因子，但核心是临床转移预测与湿实验验证，未涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测、互作建模或分子模拟，与本课题仅弱相关。
abstract: Metastasis remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality, yet predicting future metastasis is a major clinical challenge due to the lack of validated biomarkers and effective assessment methods. Here, we present EmitGCL, a deep-learning framework that accurately predicts future metastasis and its corresponding biomarkers. Based on a comprehensive benchmarking comparison, EmitGCL outperforms other computational tools across six cancer types from seven cohorts of patients with superior sensitivity and specificity. It captures occult metastatic cells in a patient with a lymph node-negative breast cancer, who was declared to have no evidence of disease by conventional imaging methods but was later confirmed to have metastatic disease. Notably, EmitGCL identifies HSP90AA1 and HSP90AB1 as predictable biomarkers for future breast cancer metastasis, which we validate by in-vitro pharmacological inhibition of HSP90 that reduced breast cancer cell migration and further support across five independent cohorts of patients (n = 420). Furthermore, we demonstrate YY1 transcription factor as a key driver of breast cancer metastasis, which we corroborate with in-silico, CRISPR-based migration assays, and in vivo mouse lung colonization experiments, suggesting that YY1 is a potential therapeutic target for further investigation.
abstract_zh: 转移仍是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，然而由于缺乏经过验证的生物标志物和有效的评估方法，预测未来转移是临床上的重大挑战。在此，我们提出EmitGCL，一种深度学习框架，能够准确预测未来转移及其相应的生物标志物。基于全面的基准比较，EmitGCL在来自七个患者队列的六种癌症类型中优于其他计算工具，具有更高的敏感性和特异性。它能够捕获一名淋巴结阴性乳腺癌患者体内的隐匿性转移细胞，该患者通过常规影像学方法被宣告无疾病证据，但后来被确认患有转移性疾病。值得注意的是，EmitGCL将HSP90AA1和HSP90AB1识别为未来乳腺癌转移的可预测生物标志物，我们通过体外药理学抑制HSP90验证了这一点，该抑制减少了乳腺癌细胞迁移，并在五个独立患者队列（n = 420）中进一步支持。此外，我们证明YY1转录因子是乳腺癌转移的关键驱动因素，并通过计算机模拟、基于CRISPR的迁移实验以及体内小鼠肺定植实验加以证实，表明YY1是一个值得进一步研究的潜在治疗靶点。
